summary: At zero-based step 32, fountain.c:drinksink selects case 13, prints the stench message, and C creates a size-one damaging gas cloud on the hero. JavaScript prints the message but skips that source call through note_unported, so C's cloud TTL draw and region side effects are absent; the next JS draw belongs to monster movement. The missing behavior is the sink caller branch, not a defect in the existing region cloud algorithm.

source.branch: drinksink case 13 is selected by rn2(20)==13 after dodrink accepts a sink prompt; the hero is standing on the sink and drinksink calls create_gas_cloud(u.ux, u.uy, 1, 4). The source function's entire case switch is already represented in JS except that this positive-damage gas-cloud call is skipped.
callers: potion.c:dodrink calls drinksink after IS_SINK and can_reach_floor pass and the user answers yes; js/potion.js:dodrink already wires that production path to js/fountain.js:drinksink.
dependencies: region.c:create_gas_cloud is already implemented by js/region.js:create_gas_cloud, including positive damage, the 1..3 TTL draw, visible region activation, hero-inside state, and the enveloped message. Its runtime caller environment requires blockPoint, canSee, newsym, and message operations.

evidence: Saved combined queue 9edb63a9a40e02e21bab96178737b56a53a8820b654e9ce5cb82375309f7ca4b and v45 evaluation b317571a6e76a6dfab39e023745bcec4ea758e55 identify the first mismatch at zero-based step 32, key y: cloud glyph cell (row 0, column 20), RNG call 2881, and cursor. The recorded C step has 32/145 screens and 103/145 cursors matched before this boundary.

nethack-c/upstream/src/fountain.c:595-712 — the whole drinksink function selects one of twenty outcomes; case 13 at lines 696-699 prints the stench and calls create_gas_cloud(u.ux, u.uy, 1, 4). The production caller is potion.c:dodrink at line 556 after the sink prompt succeeds.

nethack-c/upstream/src/region.c:1213-1308 — create_gas_cloud on cloudsize 1 skips the expansion loop, draws rn1(3,4) at line 1303, builds a region, and calls make_gas_cloud. With a damage-4 cloud centered on the hero, make_gas_cloud adds the visible region and prints the enveloped-in-noxious-gas message because the Samurai is not poison-gas immune.

The admitted recording's step 32 C RNG begins rn2(20)=13 at fountain.c:604, then rn2(3)=1 at create_gas_cloud(region.c:1303); its C screen says ‘Ew, what a stench! You are enveloped in a cloud of noxious gas!’ and displays the cloud glyph. Step 33 then reaches inside_gas_cloud with the eyes/lungs effects.

js/fountain.js:1269-1402 — drinksink case 13 prints the same stench line, then calls note_unported('region.c create_gas_cloud') instead of its already imported create_gas_cloud helper. Consequently the next recorded JS RNG is rn2(12)=0 from mon.c:mcalcmove; it has no cloud glyph or hero-inside region state.

js/region.js:962-1037 and scripts/region.test.mjs:309-353 — the canonical JS create_gas_cloud path already accepts positive damage and matches C's size-one TTL and visible activation contract; current direct tests cover the damaging helper. The remaining scope is the drinksink production call and its focused caller test, not a second region implementation.

The manifest compares the behavior with v13 scroll-created poison gas and v29 sink-quaff attempts; those do not reach this source-specific fountain.c:drinksink case-13 call. This case is the admitted C-first sink caller evidence.
